sections.content: Levellr is hiring a fully remote full stack engineer to to join our fast-growing startup. You’ll join a team working to craft an incredible product to some of the world’s largest gaming companies, brands and music labels to help them launch, grow, manage and monetize communities on Discord. Much like Hootsuite, Sprinklr & Sprout built businesses to help companies with the shift into social media platforms a decade ago, we’re helping our customers with the shift into community platforms today.

sections.heading: Who are you?
sections.content:
You have a proven ability to learn fast, ship fast, and get stuff done as part of a small team
You have 5+ years of professional software development experience, including both frontend and backend work
You want to work as part of a fully-remote development team, and you’re happy to work in a European timezone
You have strong knowledge of TypeScript and/or JavaScript
You ship beautiful web apps with frontend frameworks like Svelte, React or Vue
You’re not afraid of SQL and getting your hands dirty with relational databases like PostgreSQL
You know your way around GitHub and you’re comfortable with Git
Ideally you have previous startup/growth-stage experience and previous remote-work experience, or you’re excited to acquire that
You are self-motivated and proactive with an independent working style
You have excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

sections.heading: Who we are
sections.content: Levellr is run by two co-founders, Tom (CEO) and Ben (CTO), who have been building communities for the last 15 years at companies big (YouTube, Interpublic Group) and small (MyCujoo). We’ve been working on the business since early 2021 and are backed by Crush Ventures and a portfolio of strategic and valuable angels.

This is not your typical corporate role. Nor is this a funding-fueled hype machine without a real product that fixes real problems. We’re an early-stage startup charting our own course and building a company we would love to work for.
We work remotely. You’ll see us in calls from London coworking spaces, suburban home offices, and the occasional Airbnb.
We work flexibly. We work around school runs, workouts at the gym, meals with the kids, and the occasional random day off for day trips or long weekends.
We get stuff done. We have a bias for action and love creating value from nothing but our code and our conversations.
We thrive in uncertainty. We listen to market feedback and iterate continuously to build products our customers love.
We avoid hierarchy. We do the right thing without needing anyone to chase us or watch over our shoulders.
We aim for balance. We work to build a business that will give our teams (and their families!) balanced and happy lives for many years to come.

sections.heading: Benefits
sections.content:
We are a remote-first company and take the health and well-being of our teammates seriously. Just tell us what you need to be happy and successful, and we’ll try our best to accommodate you.
5 weeks holiday allowance (plus public holidays)
Access to Spill, our mental health platform
Hybrid remote & flexible working hours
Yearly company offsites (next one is in August!)
Stock options
Home office budget once you pass 3 months probation
Work Laptop
